verdict.rationale: First-party docs say plugins use MCP to expose server-backed tools to Codex and ChatGPT, and that a plugin can bundle MCP servers, including remote MCP-only plugins. The `@plugin-creator` skill adds MCP server wiring, plugins can carry a `.mcp.json` surface, and installed plugins add MCP tools to new chats after install via `/plugins` or `codex plugin marketplace add`. missing for 10: evidence of plugging in an arbitrary MCP server directly without wrapping it in a plugin manifest or marketplace (a new session is also required after install), and independent or hands-on corroboration of MCP tool use (community evidence covers skills only).
